primary.note: Esteh Indonesia green. Ground truth from computed background-color on live nav bar and primary buttons (248 occurrences, the single most-used non-neutral color on the site), confirmed against the logo's leaf accent (pixel-sampled at #0C8141, same family within JPEG/PNG compression tolerance).

primaryDark.note: Darker shade of the primary green, derived for hover/pressed states and the leaf's shadow vein; matches the darker edge tone sampled from the logo leaf.

leaf.note: Dominant pixel color sampled directly from the leaf accent in the real logo (logo-color.40669c9a.png), which sits above the second 'e' in the wordmark in place of an accent mark. Ground truth per brand identity.

accentYellow.note: Live site's own <h2> heading color (computed style, https://www.estehindonesia.com/), used for callouts and highlighted copy.

tintGreen.note: Pale green tint pulled from stylesheet rules on the live site; used for soft section backgrounds.

ink.note: Near-black text tone, dominant color in the wordmark and body copy (computed color on body/header/nav).

inkSoft.note: Secondary text gray pulled from the live stylesheet (27 occurrences).

inkMuted.note: Muted text gray pulled from the live stylesheet (17 occurrences).

cream.note: Warm off-white background, matched to the cream backdrop behind the real product photography (products-lineup.jpg / banner-general.jpg).

border.note: Neutral hairline/border gray, most frequent utility color on the live site (397 occurrences).

wordmark.note: The real logo reads 'es' + interpunct dot + 'teh', where the second word's accent mark is not a typographic acute accent (é), it is a small tilted green leaf glyph sitting above the 'e' in 'teh', pixel-verified from the real logo file. The template renders this literally: plain 'e' + a positioned leaf SVG (public/images/icon-leaf.svg), never the Unicode 'é' character.
